system.name: LLM development pipeline
system.one_liner: the end-to-end pipeline studied by this characterization of large language model development in the datacenter

components.name: Process Pipeline
components.role: collects, curates and tokenizes raw data

components.name: Collection
components.role: gathers raw data

components.name: Curation
components.role: cleans and filters collected data

components.name: Tokenization
components.role: converts curated data into tokens

components.name: Data Stores
components.role: stores processed datasets

components.name: Pretraining Datasets
components.role: unlabeled corpora used for pretraining

components.name: Alignment Datasets
components.role: datasets used for the alignment stage

components.role: trains the base model using a training recipe and placement strategy

components.role: defines model selection, data sampling and hyperparameter configuration

components.role: chooses the model architecture

components.name: Data Sampling

components.name: Hyperparameter Configuration
components.role: sets training hyperparameters

components.name: Placement Strategy

components.role: adjusts model weights on task-specific data

components.name: RLHF

components.name: Prompt Engineering

components.name: Evaluation
components.role: assesses model quality across tasks and metrics

components.name: Distributed Eval.

components.name: Deployment
components.role: converts and quantizes the model for serving

components.name: Conversion
components.role: converts the model format for deployment

components.name: Quantization
components.role: reduces model precision for efficient serving

flows.what: periodic alignment and evaluation loop (gray circular arrow)

content.key_idea: LLM development follows five stages, from data preparation through pretraining, alignment, evaluation and deployment, with pretraining periodically looping back into alignment and evaluation to assess and adjust intermediate models.
content.reading_order: numbered circled stages guide the eye: ① Data Preparation, ② Pretraining, ③ Alignment, ④ Evaluation, ⑤ Deployment, with a gray circular arrow marking the periodic loop between pretraining, alignment and evaluation.

encoding.color_means: blue = the five main pipeline-stage blocks and their connecting arrows; gray circular arrow = periodic feedback rather than a one-way stage transition
encoding.emphasis: circled stage numbers and the distinct gray loop arrow draw attention to the iterative relationship between pretraining, alignment and evaluation, as called out in the text
reusable_patterns: five-stage lifecycle grid with numbered ordering and a feedback loop drawn as a separate curved arrow

grey circular arrow indicates that the pretraining stage enables periodical alignment

summary: This paper characterizes large language model development in the datacenter, and Figure 1 lays out the comprehensive LLM development pipeline it studies. Five circled-numbered, blue-outlined stage boxes are arranged in a grid: ① Data Preparation (containing a Process Pipeline of Collection/Curation/Tokenization and Data Stores holding Pretraining and Alignment Datasets), ② Pretraining (a Training Recipe of Model Selection/Data Sampling/Hyperparameter Configuration alongside a Placement Strategy diagram of data/pipeline/tensor parallelism), ③ Alignment (Fine-tuning, RLHF, Prompt Engineering), ④ Evaluation (Multi-task, Multi-metric, Distributed Eval.) and ⑤ Deployment (Conversion, Quantization). Blue arrows connect the stages in numbered order, while a distinct gray circular arrow links Pretraining back to Alignment and Evaluation, depicting the periodic loop where intermediate models are assessed and configurations adjusted on the fly. Small vector icons (database cylinders, gears, a cloud) mark each sub-step, giving the dense, single-column figure an at-a-glance map of the whole lifecycle.
summary_zh: 该图展示LLM开发的五个阶段流水线：数据准备、预训练、对齐、评测与部署，用蓝色方框和编号箭头依次连接，灰色环形箭头表示预训练阶段与对齐、评测之间的周期性反馈循环。
